candidates.severity: low; documentation conflict, intent and admitted nested example remain conditional
candidates.classification: Vessel reducer documentation promises food lots at any nesting depth, while the selected implementation, its internal comment and source assertions specify direct children only.
candidates.trace: The reducer’s public documentation says all contained cookable food at any nesting depth is consumed. Its loop filters containment edges by parent equal to the selected vessel, checks each direct child for a cookable item and matching lot and amount, and never traverses child subtrees. An inline comment says nested lots remain inside their child container. If no direct child supplies a food lot and matching amount, and no earlier guard returns, the path returns the no-food error. The source-level fixture asserts the direct parent filter and absence of subtree_object_ids; it was inspected, not executed.
candidates.behavior_comparison: The physical-p16 role 204 and 95e whole files have different hashes, but their selected vessel reducer documentation and body bytes match exactly. This selected discrepancy is therefore not established as a new refactor regression. The old checkpoint 059 Lens 12 journal and Lens 13 receipt already recorded the conflict; Lens 12 source assertions had narrowed it to likely stale prose while leaving the owning policy open. These are historical observations, not 3821 authority or independent current runtime results.
candidates.interface_and_limits: Current settlement and camp routes pass the selected container object to the same reducer; the template labels the action Start cooking contents without defining depth. Generic container insertion supports containment edges subject to custody, graph and capacity guards; placing a qualifying root vessel over the fire preserves its child edges. A hypothetical inner container holding food would not be traversed by the selected reducer; actual admissibility of a specific nested vessel/item combination and player-visible effects were not established. No cooking, fixture, test, build, browser or runtime probe ran.
candidates.connected_repair: After the audit gate, confirm the owning cooking policy. If direct-only is intended as the inline comment and source assertions indicate, correct the public reducer documentation and any misleading player-facing wording to specify direct food lots; retain nested non-food containers. If depth-wide cooking is intended instead, design a deliberate traversal with custody, capacity, provenance and nested-container preservation rather than silently changing behavior.
candidates.later_acceptance: After separately authorized implementation and validation, cover direct food, only nested food, mixed direct and nested food, non-food child containers, party/personal custody, water and capacity; verify the selected interface and documentation agree with the chosen policy.
candidates.discovery: partial; product policy, concrete nested-item admissibility, UI wording and exact aliases remain open
